verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs say you can inspect diffs before merging, and worktrees let you start several agents on the same repo, a setup honored by the Agents Window and the IDE. So the desktop IDE does support diff review and multiple concurrent agent sessions. However, the diff-review evidence is a one-line tagline, and nothing documents a visual side-by-side layout of sessions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on a visual diff-review UI, explicit side-by-side multi-session layout in the desktop app, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge
